body:
Sam Chen: quick heads-up — I'm flying out early Thu (red-eye). Need someone to cover primary for the 06:00-14:00 PT block. Can do a straight swap (I'll take your evening later), or split if easier. Prefer someone comfortable with inference/runtime paging.

Rita Gomez: I can pick up primary from 06:00-12:00 PT but I have a 10:30-11:15 medical appt — would need a short shadow/backup for that window. Happy to take full handback at 12:00.

Mike Li: I can shadow/cover 10:15-11:30 PT (overlap to cover Rita's appt). If anything spikes earlier I can step in fully. Rita — want me to join the handoff call at 05:55 PT?

Rita Gomez: yes please. Ping me at 05:50 and I'll be on the bridge. Thanks Mike.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident summary (last 2h) for service=inference-runtime: 3 P1 pages, avg token latency spike 230ms -> 680ms, current error rate 0.4%. No ongoing P1s. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/inference-primary-runbook.md

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled infra maintenance Thu 11:00-11:30 PT (can cause transient 429/502). If pages occur during that window mark as maintenance-related for postmortem filtering.

Julia Park: quick checklist for swap: 1) update rota in ops-schedule, 2) add a note in oncall-log with expected gap (Rita 06-12, Mike shadow 10:15-11:30), 3) ensure alert thresholds pinned for the 11:00 maintenance. Use the CLI below to update rota.

Julia Park: ```
# assign primary for service 'inference'
ops-ctl rota assign --service inference --from "Sam Chen" --to "Rita Gomez" --start 2026-03-25T13:00:00Z --end 2026-03-25T19:00:00Z
# add shadow for Rita's appt
ops-ctl rota shadow add --service inference --user "Mike Li" --start 2026-03-25T17:15:00Z --end 2026-03-25T18:30:00Z
```

Sam Chen: timeline note — those UTC times look right for my 06:00-12:00 PT window (13:00-19:00 UTC). I'm good with the commands, please go ahead and run them or tell me to run.

Mike Li: I'll run the shadow assign now and push the oncall-log note.

Mike Li: done: shadow assigned, oncall-log entry added: "Rita primary 06-12 PT; Mike shadow 10:15-11:30 PT for medical appt; Sam to take evening cover 20:00-24:00 PT".

Rita Gomez: thanks. Two quick things: 1) if you see latency >600ms during maintenance, route to fallback model v1-small (policy: fallback-low-latency). 2) I left a quick checklist in the runbook under 'quick swaps' — steps 2-4 are helpful.

oncall-bot: runbook excerpt: "Fallback routing: /configs/fallbacks/inference -> set target=model:v1-small; enable prefix-caching; set max-batch-size=8"

Julia Park: Also, posted a short sticky in the incident channel with links to the console dashboards (latency by route, token-cost view) and the rollout artifacts. Saving the link here: https://console.internal.redwood/inference/dashboards/primary.

Sam Chen: confirmed — thanks all. I'll update my calendar and add a note in the customer-impact doc in case any customer notices during the maintenance.

Rita Gomez: confirmed on my side. I'll be on the bridge at 05:55 PT with Mike for handoff and will escalate to Julia if any persistent errors >2% after 3m.

Mike Li: standing by. If anything fires before 10:15 I'll still take it; otherwise I'll be active at 10:15 to shadow.

Julia Park: thanks team — I'll also send a quick schedule update to the ops-schedule channel and mark the maintenance window for filtering. :white_check_mark:

Sam Chen: final — swap agreed: Rita primary 06:00-12:00 PT, Mike shadow 10:15-11:30 PT, Sam covers evening 20:00-24:00 PT. Leaving a note: "reason=travel; risk=maintenance at 11:00-11:30". Appreciate the cover!
